Buildings of sleekness and elegance are scattered in the streets, with red leaves and white snow adding to its silent beauty.|[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/m/en/main/news/detail/922 '' Wuthering Waves Official Website ''] }} '''Hongzhen''' is an area of {{Location|Mt. Firmament}}. ==Description== An ancient, secluded town nestled within the tranquil embrace of Mt. Firmament. Elegant structures, scattered among the crimson leaves and tipped with pure snow, create a scene of serene beauty.
For centuries, the people of Hongzhen revere the Sentinel, who safeguards their town, as their god, praying devotedly for its blessing of lasting prosperity and longevity. Despite the year-round snowfall blanketing Mt. Firmament, the warm springs flowing from the mountains and the vibrant life of the townsfolk make the cold no more a concern.In-game Mt.
